book.name: MATEU
book.title: Eliywi no kuwaba lya Jesu Kilesite eli lina kun̄oliwa kwa MATEU

content: Olusika lwa Jesu
Eyi ebuka no lusika lwa Jesu Kilesite mwanaye Dabida mwanaye Abulahama.
Abulahama na kuleya Isaka, mi Isaka na kuleya Jakobo, Jakobo na kuleya Juda na inaye,
Juda na kuleya Pelezi ni Zela, woyo inawaye neli Tama, Mi Pelezi na kuleya Heziloni, Heziloni nakuleya Alama,
Alama nakuleya Aminadabi, woyo onakuleya Nashoni, Nashoni nakuleya Salumoni.
Salomoni nakuleya Boazi, woyo inawaye neli Lahaba. Boazi nakuleya Obedi woyo inawaye neli Lusi, Obedi nakuleya Jese.
Cwale Jese nakuleya Mbumu Dabida, Dabida nakuleya Solomoni, woyo inawaye neli moyo waye Uliya.
Solomoni nakuleya Lehoboami, Lehoboami nakuleya Abiya, mi Abiya nakuleya Asa,
Asa nakuleya Jehosifati, Jehosifati nakuleya Jolami, Jolami nakuleya Uziya.
Uziya nakuleya Jotamu, Jotamu nakuleya Ahazi, Akazi nakuleya Ezekiya.
Ezekiya nakuleya Manase, Manase nakuleya Amoni, Amoni nakuleya Josiya.
Mi Josiya nakuleya Jekoniya, nainaye ba nako no mwendo woo ba nako ana kutwaliwa ku ukoba mu Babilona.
Munyima no kutwaliwa ku Babilona, Jekoniya nakuleya Shelutelo, Shelutelo nakuleya Zelubabele.
Zelubabele nakuleya Abihundi, Abihundi nakuleya Aliyakimu, Aliyakimu nakuleya Aza.
Aza nakuleya Zadoki, Zadoki nakuleya Akimi, Akimi nakuleya Elihudi.
Elihudi nakuleya Eliyaza, Eliyaza nakuleya Matani, Matani nakuleya Jakobo.
Mi Jakobo nakuleya Josefa munuwaye Maliya, Maliya inawaye Jesu woyo oisaniwa nji Kilesite.

Mi cwale, kame kuli amasika no kukwana likumi ni tunee (14), okutunda kwa Abulahama okutwala kwa Dabida likumi ni tunee (14) okutunda kwa Dabida okutwala ba kutwaliwa ku Babilona, mi likumi ni tunee (14) okutuda ba kutwaliwa ku Babilona okwiiya ba kuleiwa kwa Kilesite.
Okuleiwa kwa Jesu Kilesite

Omu omuna kwiyela okuleiwa kwa Jesu Kilesite. Maliya inawaye kame ana kubeleziwa nji akwaliwe ku mulume oisaniwa Josefa, kono abo kaasiku kukwata kale, sebeli olimuka nji kame aimanine mu mundi ku maata no Mebo No Kukena.
Josefa neli omunu no kuluka, mi kasikusinga okwenisa Maliya balubala no aanu. Kaba ana kulela oku mukana kumukunda.

Abo yolemine okunahana nji atende ngeeso, omone! Elin̄eloi lya Mbumu Nyambe sebeli liku monahaza kutulo ni kwamba nji, “Josefa mwanaye Dabida, olese kucila okukwata Maliya okumutenda mukatowe, kakuli eso akushimbile kame situnda ku Mebo No Kukena.
Mba leye omwana no ndumbana mi mba umutumbu elitina lya Jesu, kakuli mba yoyisa aanu aye kuuyi woo.”
Eyi yonje nai kutendahala okwiyateteta eyi ina kwambiwa kwa Mbumu Nyambe ku munuhi waye.
“Komumone, omukatana no kwa kuwana ni mulume mbaikala ba meyi no ubya mi mba leye omwana no ndumbani, mi mbamwisana nji Imanuwele.” (Okutalusa nji, “Nyambe kame ali netu).”
Cwale Josefa abana inguka, sebeli otenda kanyi omo linamu ambelele elingeloi, mi sebeli omukwata.
Kono kasi kulangananga naye konji aba ana kuleya omwana no ndumbana, mi sebeli omutumba elitina lya Jesu.
